newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon (HK) 1996 net loss HK$82.29 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon (HK) 1996 net loss HK$82.29 mln.

text.p: Shr (H.K. cents) 17.0 loss vs 12.9 loss (see note)
Exceptional items 18.82 gain vs 63.77 loss (see note)
Company name Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd
NOTE - Lam Soon (Hong Kong) subsidiaries are engaged in food processing and electronics trading.

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$36.69 million on disposal of partial interests in subsidiaries, gain of HK$51.63 million on disposal of other investments, gain of HK$21.11 million on dilution of interest in a subsidiary, gain of HK$45.09 million on disposal of properties, loss of HK$16.20 million on disposal and closing down of subsidiaries, loss of HK$16.94 million from revaluation deficit of a property, loss of HK$17.89 million from relocation expenses, loss of HK$20.88 million on provision for bad debts, and loss of HK$63.79 million on provision for slow-moving and obsolete stocks.

The accounting policy for deferred expenditure, which in prior year was amortized over a period of three to fifteen years, was changed during the year ended December 31, 1996. Such expenditure is now written off in the year in which it is incurred. It is considered that the new policy will give a more appropriate presentation of the results and the financial position of the group.

On the basis of the new accounting policy, the losses attributable to shareholders for 1996 and 1995 have been increased by HK$11.41 million and HK$26.05 million respectively and the results for 1995 was restated accordingly.
Total dividend for year is nil vs 1.5 H.K. cents.
